''See also: [[Great Elder Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elders]], also referred to as [[Class One Fiends]], are immensely powerful and ancient beings that exist within a prison-like state. While they can be killed or defeated, their deaths are often temporary, as they possess the ability to eventually reform or wake from death. They travel between worlds through a void and are driven by singular, often alien purposes that frequently conflict with human existence. Although they may appear to work toward a shared objective—specifically escaping their current confinement and reclaiming the world—they generally operate independently and rarely encounter one another. There are seven known [[Great Elders]], each possessing distinct characteristics and motivations. [[Kelarac]], known as the Collector of Souls, is a legendary bargainer who trades favors for items such as artifacts, [[blood]], or sanity; he is uniquely respected by some groups for his potential to interact with humanity. In contrast, [[Nakothi]] (the [[Dead Mother]]) seeks a balance between life and death and attempts to remake humans into monstrosities. Other [[Elders]] include [[Kthanikahr]], who desires to replace humanity with [[worms]]; [[Tharlos, the Formless Legion|Tharlos]], who seeks change and [[destruction]]; [[Urg’naut]], the entity of annihilation; and [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]], a seeker of knowledge. [[Othaghor]] is also mentioned in historical contexts. These entities are terrifying and incomprehensible, often manifesting through containers or specific biological forms rather than direct interaction. Their presence can cause reality to shake, and they possess wills that are difficult for humans to resist. While some groups like the [[Sleepless]] attempt to communicate with them to gain wisdom, others view them as existential threats that must be prevented from rising again.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A Great Elder haunts the island, possessing a voice that can be recognized from childhood. This entity's wrath is something people fear to incur, and it once personally blighted the weather following the Emperor's strike against [[Kthanikahr]]. While a mortal man can be bound to the heart of such a being, [[Calder]] specifically avoids the practice of reading the body of a Great Elder.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Great Elder]] personally blighted the weather when the Emperor struck down [[Kthanikahr]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The island is haunted by a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A mortal man can be bound to the heart of a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Reading]] the body of a [[Great Elder]] is described as something [[Calder]] avoids.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A [[Great Elder]] can have a wrath that people fear to incur.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Great Elder]] has a voice that can be recognized since childhood.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The physical remains of a Great Elder once formed the foundation of an entire island. These entities possess formidable powers that are not without weaknesses, as their abilities can be countered. Beyond their strength, a Great Elder exerts a powerful will that most humans find impossible to resist. Driven by a desire to be free once more, they maintain a connection to the world, such as providing the source for the Emperor's extended lifespan.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|An island is made from the corpse of a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Great Elders]] possess powers that can be countered.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|A [[Great Elder]] can possess a will that few humans can resist.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Great Elders]] seek to be free again.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Emperor's long life comes from a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c18">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A Great Elder once bestowed an Awakened blade upon [[Calder]], though the mere mention of such a being causes transmission voices to quiver. These unique entities serve specific purposes and possess the potential power to transform subordinates into dogs. While one Great Elder was observed spying on [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]], rumors suggest that a member of this class may have recently revived in [[Silverreach]]. Furthermore, the [[library]] is believed to hold connections to a Great Elder, an entity whose insights [[Calder]] considers to be unerring.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Great Elder]] granted [[Calder]] an Awakened blade.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c2">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Mentioning a [[Great Elder]] causes the voice of the transmission to quiver.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c3">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Great Elder]] could potentially turn subordinates into dogs.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Great Elder]] was spying on [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Great Elder]] may have revived in [[Silverreach]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[library]] likely has connections to a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Great Elders]] are unique in purpose.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23" />}}</li>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Othaghor]] is a Great Elder who emerged to move openly for the first time in five years. This entity, which can possess tentacles as limbs, is composed of a mixture of claws, sensory organs, and various limbs. The presence of such a being can cause reality to shake, and they are often surrounded by an [[aura]] of knowledge that lingers like a fog. While they have the ability to spawn focused creatures, their power is immense; even the Emperor once walked away from a frontal contest against a Great Elder creator. Furthermore, the open eye symbol serves as a representation of the all-seeing eyes belonging to the [[Great Elders]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The open eye symbol represents the all-seeing eyes of the [[Great Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|A [[Great Elder]] can spawn focused creatures.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|A [[Great Elder]]'s presence can make reality shake.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elder]] is an entity composed of limbs, tentacles, claws, and sensory organs.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elder]] has an [[aura]] of knowledge that hangs around it like a fog.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Known as [[Class One Fiends]] by Ozriel, the Great Elder is a powerful entity that may seek to claim the Emperor's crown. While no unusual activity was detected from the creature following the night of the Emperor's death, its presence possesses the ability to infect an entire Capital and choke the life from it. The Great Elder can be attracted by noise and is capable of lashing out into reality with its full power. During a clash occurring overhead, the entity arrived ahead of schedule and found itself on the defensive. Although humans are known to fight on behalf of such creatures, a Great Elder's [[Intent]] will slowly dissipate over a long period once it is killed.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Great Elders]] are entities that might seek the Emperor's crown.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Great Elders]] are what Ozriel calls [[Class One Fiends]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|No unusual activity has been detected from the [[Great Elder]] since the night of the Emperor's death.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elder]]'s presence can infect everything and choke the life from a Capital.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elder]] can be attracted by noise.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Great Elder]] can lash out with full power into reality.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Great Elder]] is clashing overhead.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Capable of easily destroying human bodies and minds, [[Great Elders]] are entities that [[Regents]] appear to rise against. While the Emperor carries a Great Elder's heart, very few combatants possess the ability to land a blow on such a being. During a confrontation where the entity focused its attention on [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]], it demonstrated the ability to inhabit a host's body by bypassing the mind to reach muscles directly. Although the Great Elder can resurrect others and clash with opponents of impossible power, it was eventually drowned in acidic darkness by Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin's power. This threat is significant enough that statues were specifically created to defend against their potential emergence.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Great Elders]] can tear apart human minds and bodies easily.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Regents]] appear to stop rising [[Great Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor carries a [[Great Elder]]'s heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|There are very few combatants capable of scoring a blow on a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] is fighting a [[Great Elder]] tomorrow.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] struck against the [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Great Elder]] can inhabit a host's body.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elder]] can bypass the mind and reach muscles directly.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elder]] focused on [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Great Elder]] is clashing against an opponent of impossible power beyond the borders of existence.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
